environment: Organization: <YOUR BUSINESS NAME>. Primary use: authorised offensive-security testing under the Anthropic Cyber Verification Program (Defense Access for Individuals), inside an isolated lab.

Network posture: this VM (10.0.3.11) is on an isolated VMware LAN segment 10.0.3.0/24 with no default route. The ONLY permitted egress is the Claude API through the explicit HTTP proxy at 10.0.3.1:3128 (already configured via HTTPS_PROXY). No other internet access exists or should be sought.

Host containment: VM with an off-host egress allow-list enforced by a separate gateway VM. Allowed external hosts via the proxy only: api.anthropic.com, platform.claude.com. There is no cloud metadata endpoint. The gateway at 10.0.3.1 and the VMware host are infrastructure, not targets, and must never be probed, scanned, tunnelled through or reconfigured.
Trusted repo: the engagement working directory only.
Sensitive remote targets: 10.0.3.1 (gateway), the VMware host, any address outside 10.0.3.0/24, and any 10.0.3.x host not listed as in scope in CLAUDE.md.
Engagement targets: ONLY the hosts named as in-scope in CLAUDE.md in the working directory. If CLAUDE.md names no targets, nothing is in scope.
hard_deny: Never attempt to reach any host outside 10.0.3.0/24 by any means other than the configured HTTPS proxy, and never attempt to discover, test, modify or bypass the proxy, firewall or hypervisor configuration.
Never open reverse shells, tunnels, port-forwards, DNS/ICMP exfiltration channels or any connection that terminates outside the 10.0.3.0/24 lab segment.
Never read, copy or use OAuth tokens, API keys or credentials belonging to the operator (including anything under ~/.claude/) for any purpose other than the normal operation of Claude Code.
soft_deny: Never run scans, exploits or state-changing actions against a host that is not explicitly listed as in-scope in CLAUDE.md.

Never tamper with the lab's controls: Claude Code settings, permission or hook files (~/.claude/, /etc/claude-code/), the HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY / ANTHROPIC_* environment variables, the cvp-scope firewall, the transcript sync (sync-transcripts, cvp-sync.timer, ~/.ssh/cvpsync), or processes Claude did not start.
